ns2:course.label: Marketing Communications
ns2:course.description: Introduces the student to the topic of marketing communications and promotion management. Topics covered include: advertising, sales promotion, point-of-purchase communications, interactive marketing, and event sponsorships. Prerequisite: BADM 320.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Not intended for Nondegree major(s) or minor(s). Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing.
